zh.title: 俄軍機穿越臺灣防空識別區 國防部譴責衝擊區域穩定
zh.summary: 國防部表示已掌握俄軍機動態並適切應處，譴責其行為衝擊區域和平穩定。
body: 針對俄羅斯軍機11月17日航經臺灣東部空域，副參謀總長執行官黃志偉上將18日表示，俄軍機清晨穿越臺灣防空識別區，國軍依相關規定，運用聯合情監偵手段掌握並適切應處。
黃志偉表示，俄軍機穿越防空識別區及侵犯鄰國領空的行為，衝擊區域和平穩定，也不利臺海現狀，國防部予以譴責。防空識別區與領空不同，這項說明不等同指稱俄軍機進入臺灣領空。
對於國軍是否派出軍機因應，黃志偉基於國防安全原則，未透露兵力派遣及部署細節，但表示國軍嚴密掌握情況。國防部將持續運用情監偵手段監控相關動態。

en.title: Taiwan condemns Russian military aircraft activity after ADIZ transit
en.summary: Taiwan’s defence ministry says it monitored Russian military aircraft and responded appropriately, without disclosing deployment details.
body: Taiwan’s defence ministry said Russian military aircraft crossed its air defence identification zone early on November 17. Speaking on November 18, General Huang Chih-wei said the armed forces used joint intelligence, surveillance and reconnaissance capabilities to monitor the activity and respond under established procedures.

Huang condemned the activity, including reported violations of a neighbouring country’s airspace, as harmful to regional stability. An air defence identification zone is distinct from sovereign airspace; his account does not establish that the aircraft entered Taiwan’s territorial airspace.

Asked whether Taiwan sent aircraft to respond, Huang declined to disclose deployment details on national security grounds. He said the military maintained close awareness of the situation and would continue monitoring relevant movements.

image.subjectEn: Taiwan Ministry of National Defense’s Boai compound in Dazhi; file photo, not the aircraft activity.

facts.claim: General Huang Chih-wei said Russian aircraft crossed Taiwan’s ADIZ early on November 17 and Taiwan monitored and responded appropriately.
Taiwan’s defence ministry condemned the activity as harmful to regional peace and stability.
Huang declined to disclose deployment details on national security grounds.
